methods.displayName: Find books in the Arceuus Library

start.instruction: Find and return one requested text, then apply the resulting book of arcane knowledge to Magic. Scope one delivery and recheck inventory before continuing.

hardRequirements.description: A real Magic level is required so the experience reward can scale from it.

freeInventorySlots.description: One ordinary empty position for a requested library text or its knowledge-book reward.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Magic target.

costs.assumptions: Travel and book-location knowledge are unestimated. One delivery is scoped; energy support is optional.

methods.reason: A rune-free Magic path that can become ready from ordinary live skill and inventory facts.

requirements.description: One ordinary empty position for the scoped delivery.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified delivery start; no sustained route or hourly reward rate is claimed.

sources.notes: The UIM Magic guide was reviewed for low-resource training priorities and inventory constraints.
Customer requests, text delivery, books of arcane knowledge and Magic experience selection were reviewed; Kourend favour is no longer a gate.

methods.displayName: Make the next Telekinetic Theatre move

start.location: Mage Training Arena north of Emir's Arena
start.instruction: Use one Telekinetic Grab with exact carried law and air runes for the next maze move. This is a bounded cast, not proof of enough runes to complete a maze or reward grind.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 33 required for Telekinetic Grab and this room.

freeInventorySlots.description: No ordinary empty position is required for the scoped cast; reward-space planning is outside this start.

consumes.description: One exact carried law rune for the next Telekinetic Grab cast.
One exact carried air rune for the next Telekinetic Grab cast without a staff substitution.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Magic target.
Stop before the next cast when carried law runes are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: Only the next cast and maze are scoped. No elemental-staff substitution, complete reward budget or future rune purchase is assumed.

methods.reason: A safe, goal-relevant Magic activity when the next law-and-air-rune-funded cast is observable.

requirements.description: One exact carried air rune for the next cast.
One exact carried law rune for the next cast.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified next cast at the safe arena; no complete-maze budget, reward budget or hourly rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies Mage Training Arena as a major early Magic path with a sizeable rune cost.
The arena is safe; level 33 Telekinetic Grab and multi-cast maze behavior were reviewed.
The exact base cost of one law rune and one air rune was reviewed; staff substitution is not inferred.
Exact law-rune and air-rune identities use pinned public gameval constants.

methods.displayName: Cast Fire Strike at sand crabs

start.instruction: Cast one Fire Strike using exact carried runes, then reassess the bounded combat session. No safespot, food, prayer, death safety or long-term rune supply is assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 13 required to cast Fire Strike.

freeInventorySlots.description: No empty position is required for the next cast; loot and sustained-session capacity are outside scope.

consumes.description: One exact carried mind rune for one Fire Strike.
Two exact carried air runes for one Fire Strike without a staff substitution.
Three exact carried fire runes for one Fire Strike without a staff substitution.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Magic target.
Stop before another cast when mind runes are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One spell cast is modeled. Staff substitutions, ammunition longevity, health, food, prayer and monster safety are deliberately unproven.

methods.reason: A conservative low-level combat start whose exact next-cast rune cost must be present.

requirements.description: Three fire runes for the next cast.
Two air runes for the next cast.
One mind rune for the next cast.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified cast against a low-defence training monster; no sustained combat or XP rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide supports early spell combat while emphasizing rune conservation; this record scopes only one cast.
Level 13 and the exact base rune cost of one mind, two air and three fire runes were reviewed.
Sand crabs are low-defence training monsters; the record does not claim immunity from damage or a safe indefinite session.
Exact mind, air and fire rune identities use pinned public gameval constants.
